leadText: Kicking It from Here into Tomorrow! (Japanese: ヒバニー、炎のキック！明日に向かって！！ , Use Your Flaming Kick! Face Tomorrow!!) is the sixth chapter of the manga. It is based on the animated series episode by the same name.
